questions.explanation: The points equidistant from \(5 - 2i\) and \(-4 - 2i\) lie on the perpendicular bisector of the segment joining them. Squaring \((x-5)^2+(y+2)^2=(x+4)^2+(y+2)^2\) and simplifying gives \(2x=1\).
Combine real parts and imaginary parts separately: \(-8 + 3i\).

questions.prompt: In which quadrant of the Argand plane does \(z=-8 - 2i\) lie?
questions.explanation: The real part is negative and the imaginary part is negative, so the point is in the third quadrant.

questions.prompt: A particle in simple harmonic motion has displacement \(x=x_{max}e^{i\theta}\). If \(x_{max}=8\) cm, find \(x\) when \(\theta=\frac{2\pi}{3}\).
questions.explanation: \(x=x_{max}(\cos\theta+i\sin\theta)=8\left(- \frac{1}{2}+i\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)=-4 + 4 \sqrt{3}i\) cm.
